style_bible.name: Mediterranean Night Noir
style_bible.core: Stylized neo-noir editorial graphic-novel illustration, expressive painterly oil-and-ink brushwork reminiscent of Disco Elysium and classic European crime comics, crisp sculptural planes, subtle canvas paper grain, cinematic chiaroscuro lighting
style_bible.palette: deep midnight coastal indigo (#0b1528), slate shadow blue (#182842), warm sodium streetlamp amber (#f5a623), Catalan terracotta (#c4633e), crisp cyan blueprint rim accent (#38bdf8), muted crimson highlights
style_bible.negative: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO WORDS, NO NUMBERS, NO TYPOGRAPHY, NO SIGNAGE LETTERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARKS, NO BORDERS, NO FRAMES, NO UI ELEMENTS

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: widescreen video game title screen key art backdrop
Scene/backdrop: Salou Mediterranean coastal promenade at midnight in Catalonia, wet rain-slick boulevard reflecting lights, rows of tall Mediterranean palm trees silhouetted against a deep midnight coastal sky and distant dark Balearic Sea horizon, warm modernist coastal hotels and terracotta townhouses along the left side glowing with abstract amber and cyan neon architectural light strips (pure geometric light tubes only, zero text or letters).
Subject: In the lower-right foreground, a sleek low-slung dark European sport coupe getaway car parked in moody three-quarter rear-side silhouette along the wet curb, warm amber sodium streetlamp rays cutting through coastal sea mist, subtle red taillights reflecting on damp dark asphalt, a lone trench-coated figure faintly glimpsed near the palms watching the glowing hotel strip.
Style/medium: Stylized Mediterranean Night Noir editorial illustration, expressive painterly oil-and-ink brushwork like Disco Elysium meets European graphic novel crime art, atmospheric depth, rich canvas grain.
Composition/framing: Cinematic wide 16:9 panoramic shot with generous dark atmospheric midnight sky and quiet negative space in the upper-left and center-left for game title typography overlay.
Lighting/mood: Moody neo-noir tension, warm sodium streetlamp amber pools contrasting against deep midnight indigo shadows and subtle cyan neon rim highlights.
Color palette: Deep midnight blue, warm sodium amber gold, Catalan terracotta, cool cyan neon accents, wet charcoal tarmac.
Constraints: Pure artwork only. Leave clean uncluttered dark sky space in upper-left for external title overlay.
Avoid: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO WORDS, NO SIGNS WITH WRITING, NO LICENSE PLATE NUMBERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARKS, NO UI.

assets.usage: Act 1 story briefing panel: dim Salou bar with blueprints on wax tracing paper
assets.prompt:

Asset type: widescreen 16:9 story cutscene illustration for a crime heist game
Scene/backdrop: Inside a dimly lit late-night Catalan corner bar in Salou. Dark weathered timber counter, amber bottles glowing softly along the back shelves, ceramic terracotta tiles on the lower wall, rain-beaded window in the back looking out onto a midnight-blue street with palm fronds and warm sodium streetlamps.
Subject: At a corner wooden booth table beneath a low hanging warm brass pendant lamp, two silhouetted figures lean closely over spread-out translucent wax tracing paper (butterbrotpapier) covered with hand-drawn pencil architectural floorplan lines and red grease-pencil route arrows (pure geometric room outlines and arrows ONLY, zero text or numbers). A 34-year-old woman in a dark field jacket points a brass ruler at a floorplan corner while a 68-year-old man in a flatcap and trench coat holds a wooden pencil beside two half-empty espresso glasses and a vintage mechanical stopwatch.
Style/medium: Stylized Mediterranean Night Noir editorial illustration, expressive painterly oil-and-ink brushwork like Disco Elysium meets classic European crime graphic novels, atmospheric smoke haze and rich shadows.
Composition/framing: Cinematic widescreen 16:9 over-the-table mid-wide angle, warm pool of amber pendant light anchoring the floorplan in the center-foreground, deep midnight blue corners.
Lighting/mood: Intimate conspiratorial neo-noir warmth against dark Mediterranean coastal midnight outside.
Color palette: Deep midnight indigo, rich mahogany shadow, glowing tungsten amber, translucent cream parchment, Catalan terracotta, subtle cyan window glow.

assets.usage: Act 3 finale story panel: baroque Dresden night silhouette and illuminated fictional royal treasure vault
assets.prompt:

Asset type: widescreen 16:9 finale cutscene illustration for a crime heist game
Scene/backdrop: A dramatic split-depth architectural night scene of historic baroque Dresden and a grand fictional royal treasure chamber. Through tall arched baroque sandstone windows, the nocturnal silhouette of baroque domes, spires, and the dark Elbe river mist glows faintly under a midnight sapphire sky. Inside the vaulted chamber: ornate gilded baroque sandstone columns, checkerboard marble floors, and sleek modern museum security glass vitrines bathed in dramatic spotlights.
Subject: Inside the hushed illuminated baroque treasure hall, gleaming royal jewels, emerald-and-gold ceremonial regalia, and antique gilded artifacts rest inside fortified glass display cases crisscrossed by faint delicate cyan security laser beams and subtle amber architectural uplighting. In the shadowy foreground archway, the faint silhouette of a heist specialist crouches beside a glowing security junction box.
Style/medium: Stylized Night Noir editorial illustration, expressive painterly oil-and-ink brushwork like Disco Elysium meets classic European crime graphic novels, monumental architectural drama and refined lighting.

Lighting/mood: Tense high-stakes heist finale — cold midnight blue and razor-thin cyan security laser lines slicing across warm baroque gold and sandstone shadows.
Color palette: Deep Prussian midnight blue, aged baroque sandstone ochre, radiant museum gold, crisp security laser cyan, deep obsidian shadow.
